findings.evidence: The definition is at lines 51–54; the only single-basis lemmas are for `ofMulActionIsoCongr` at lines 70–82.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas for the equivalence and its inverse on `MonoidAlgebra.single`, or make this construction private if only the wrapper is intended as API.
findings.issue: Public `ofMulActionEquivCongr` has no forward or inverse application lemmas, although its body is hidden; only the later `Rep` isomorphism wrapper is characterized.

findings.evidence: Confirmed representative-only binders at OfMulAction.lean:99–108 and 117–122, and PermutationModule/Extremes.lean:60–67 and 109–117; quotient bases are indexed by arbitrary `q : G ⧸ H`.
findings.fix: State the characteristic hom/inverse lemmas for arbitrary quotient elements, using `Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq` or `QuotientGroup.quotientBot` on the right; retain representative forms as corollaries if useful.
findings.issue: The quotient isomorphism API only evaluates basis elements whose coset is syntactically a representative `(x : G ⧸ H)`, so it cannot rewrite `single q r` for an arbitrary quotient-basis index; the same restriction occurs for `quotientIsoCongr` hom/inv, `quotientBotIsoLeftRegular` hom, and both extreme permutation-module hom lemmas.

summary: The public equivalences and quotient isomorphisms remain incompletely characterized for downstream use without unfolding or quotient induction.
